InvalidCredentials: Verify brand token failed, maybe expired or can't be decrypted.
InvalidOrExpiredPlayerToken: Verify player token failed, maybe expired or missing token.
ClientIdNotFound: Can't not find input client id.
PlayerNotFound: Player is not found in the system.
CurrencyMismatch: The input currency is not matched to player's currency.
InvalidGameAction: Error occurres in game action process.
TransactionIdNotFound: The transaction or reference transaction is not found (either settle or cancel).
InvalidAmount: The input amount is invalid ( NAN, positive only, etc. ).
IncorrectFormat: The format of request is invalid.
UnderMaintenance: Reseller / Licensee / Brand / GameProvider / Game is under maintenace.
InvalidStatus: Brand / GameProvider / Game / GPC status is not valid.
OperationNotAllowed: For api function is restricted for some reason.
